strategy_name: Weather Edge Engine Blended Single v0
description: Shadow strategy that keeps the current single-market decision shape but replaces raw model probability with the configured market-anchored blended probability. It does not submit orders.

decision_rule.trade_condition: entry window passes and side-aware blended edge >= profile min_edge

current_findings.loose_edge_0_03: blended improves raw on opportunity full/recent/live_filled subsets, but this does not preserve current live gates
current_findings.entry_band_aware: when current entry windows and min_edge gates are preserved, blended selects far fewer legs and is not robust on recent/live_filled subsets
current_findings.selected_initial_paper_range: Historical June selection only: blended min_edge 0.05 was once chosen for paper observation; the 2026-08-13 replay supersedes that promotion narrative.
current_findings.production_read: do not directly replace current live gates; after weak ECMWF city removal and T28 ban, blended hard gate has negative marginal value versus the new operational base; use N100 shadow double-write first and research blended sizing separately
current_findings.latest_overlay_2026_06_08: On settled mid_price_core_v1_25_75 live_real fills, removing BuenosAires/Munich/Jeddah/Karachi/Moscow/Ankara and banning hours_to_settle > 28 improves post PnL from -89.06 to +39.53; adding blended_edge>=0.10 lowers it to +20.19.
current_findings.latest_replay_2026_08_13: Dormant: both blended profiles were negative on holdout-from-2026-05-26 and recent-from-2026-06-01 slices; full-history gains were tail-dependent and submitted fill-rate scaling was not actual execution evidence.

blended_25_75_e05.city_scope: current operational T1 blend shadow cities excluding weak ECMWF cities; BuenosAires is not in this profile

blended_side_band_e05.city_scope: legacy core cities: Boston, LA, London, Miami, NYC, Phoenix, Shanghai, Tokyo, Warsaw
